subtitle: Ipuzzle yesibuko esisodwa
short_description: Dubula kanye, bikezela ukubuya kwemisebe, uhlanze wonke amabhodi.
description: Hlosa kanye, dubula, bese ubikezela ukuthi umsebe uzobuya kanjani kusukela ezibukweni ezimisiwe ukuze uhlanze wonke amatagethi. Lungisa ikona yakho bese uzama futhi ngaphandle kwesibali-sikhathi. Hlola amabhodi amasha angu-8 futhi ugcine inqubekelaphambili yasendaweni. Udubulo lumisa uma amatagethi ehlanziwe, lushiya ibhodi, noma kufinyelelwe umkhawulo wokubuya okune.
